The *Pathavicalanapañha* ("The Question on the Causes of Earthquakes", Mil 5.1.4) is a dialogue situated within the *Milindapañha* [SuttaCentral]. The work investigates the doctrinal and cosmological reasons for the trembling of the earth, a topic with notable roots across canonical Buddhist literature [SuttaCentral]. English translations of the text include one by John Kelly [SuttaCentral].
Curated parallels recorded on SuttaCentral identify a passage-level parallel in the *Cariyāpiṭaka* (Cp 9, *Vessantaracariya*) and note thematic relationships with discourse discussions on earthquakes in the *Bhūmicālasutta* (AN 8.70), the *Mahāparinibbāna Sutta* (DN 16), the *Vessantarajātaka* (Ja 547), the *Kathāvatthu* (Kv 11.5), and Chinese Āgama parallels (MA 36 and EA 42.5) [SuttaCentral].
